source.note: The GitHub connector content commits did not trigger a workflow run in the observed session. This file preserves the independently executed local replay only and is not an immutable Actions artifact.

why_each_frozen_rule_rejects.TAUTOLOGY_DELETION: No clause contains a literal and its negation.
why_each_frozen_rule_rejects.UNIT_PROPAGATION_WITH_RECONSTRUCTION_TRA: All clauses have width 3; no unit clause exists.
why_each_frozen_rule_rejects.PURE_LITERAL_AUTARKY: Every variable occurs in both polarities.
why_each_frozen_rule_rejects.SUBSUMPTION: All clauses have equal width 3 and no distinct clause is a subset of another.
why_each_frozen_rule_rejects.BLOCKED_CLAUSE_ELIMINATION: No clause/literal pair is blocked under the frozen resolution-environment test.
why_each_frozen_rule_rejects.BOUNDED_VARIABLE_ELIMINATION: For each of the 12 variables there are 4 positive and 4 negative occurrences. Elimination yields 8 unique non-tautological resolvents replacing 8 incident clauses, so clause count stays 32; literal occurrences increase from 96 to 104. The frozen lexicographic progress measure therefore rejects every BVE candidate.

captain_interpretation.what_was_confirmed: Certified decision-safe deletion is implementable and useful on positive controls.
captain_interpretation.what_failed: The fixed polynomially checkable rule stack does not guarantee progress on all frozen 3-CNFs.
captain_interpretation.important_boundary: This stalled core falsifies the completeness of the R33 rule stack only; it does not falsify the existence of a different polynomial progress rule or P=NP.
captain_interpretation.next_allowed_action_after_seal: R34 may add exactly one new preregistered polynomial-time detectable proof-carrying SAT-preserving progress rule targeted at this sealed core.
